description: R3+ orphan-works research-only carve-out. Per ADR-2605265000 N2: orphan works (works whose copyright holder cannot be identified or located) are NEVER admitted to baien-distill training corpus. R3+ permits research-only access (NOT training) via Council Lv6+ ≥3 per-work attestation. Diligent-search MUST be documented per US Copyright Office Orphan Works Best Practices 2015. Work MUST be ≥95 years old (US 1923 + 5-yr safety buffer). researchOnlyNotTrainingAttested const true STRUCTURAL.

workEstimatedYear.description: G STRUCTURAL: work MUST be ≥95 yr old (current year - 95); for 2026, maximum = 1931

workMinAgeYears.description: STRUCTURAL: ≥95 yr safety buffer (US 1923 rule + 5 yr)

councilLv6PlusAttestations.description: STRUCTURAL: Council Lv6+ ≥3 DIDs attesting to this R3+ research carve-out

diligentSearchDocumentationCid.description: STRUCTURAL: IPFS CID of diligent-search documentation per US Copyright Office Orphan Works Best Practices 2015. Documentation MUST include: search of US Copyright Office records / WATCH file / VIAF / national-library catalogs / Google + alternative search engines / professional registries / industry directories / good-faith outreach attempts (where contact information available)

researchOnlyNotTrainingAttested.description: STRUCTURAL: const true; this work is admitted for research-only access; explicitly NOT admitted to baien-distill training corpus; admitting cell MUST enforce read-only-not-train flag

presumedAuthorOrRightsHolder.description: Best-effort identification of presumed author or rights-holder; may be 'unknown', a name, or a corporation

researchPurposeCid.description: IPFS CID of stated research purpose document (academic / historical / cultural preservation / etc.)

accessRestrictionsCid.description: IPFS CID of access restrictions document (who may access, under what conditions, for what duration)

councilReviewIntervalDays.description: Council re-review interval (default 365 days); orphan-works carve-outs expire and require Council Lv6+ ≥3 re-attestation
